packageRules.description: What this demo exists to show: the registry, and the CLI and plugin a reader runs against it. Their own PR, never grouped with tooling, so CI's compose job proves each bump before anyone reads the README against it.
Held at 5.106: newer releases don't build with @module-federation/enhanced 2.9, as appshell-quickstart found.
Keycloak and MongoDB match what the hosted registry runs; a major is a decision.
Build tooling can't reach a reader's browser except through the build CI runs. One grouped PR a week.
The seed image's bases, pinned by digest: node builds it, distroless runs it. One PR for both, which CI builds and seeds with.
This repository releases the seed's image, and sets its version in compose.yaml before tagging it (.github/workflows/release.yml).
